name: Firecrawl
description: Turn any web page into clean Markdown, map a site's links, or crawl a site depth-limited — with a live spider console that shows every fetch, refusal and failure as it happens.
tab.label: Crawler
action.openConsole.label: Crawler console
prompt.console.instructions: The Firecrawl crawler console is open in the activity panel. Use firecrawl_scrape for a single page, firecrawl_map to discover URLs, and firecrawl_crawl when the user wants several pages: start from the page they named, keep the defaults unless they ask for more, and say which rule refused the links you skipped.
spider.title: Spider web
spider.empty: start a crawl to wake the spider
spider.aria: Radial map of the crawl: the start page at the center, each ring one link hop further out. Filled dots are fetched pages, dashed spokes are links that were refused.
console.title: Crawler console
console.subtitle: no crawl yet
console.empty: No activity yet. Start a crawl here, or ask the agent to scrape a page.
console.error.badUrl: Enter an absolute http(s) URL first.
